_readme: Edit freely: species, level, types, ability, item, moves, location. 'sprite' is the slug for the Pokemon GIF (variants use 'unown-question' until real sprites exist). Each move's type is in its 'type' field. 'hidden': true = spoiler battle, opens only after clicking. 'role' is optional (gym leaders have none). 'game-id' = the trainer IDs in the game's trainer data (all the variants of that battle; not shown on the site). 'double': true = double battle; 'sprite' can be a list for two trainers. 'color' (optional) = accent colour of the trainer's row, instead of the colour of the team's main type.

meta.itemSlugRule: lowercase item name, spaces become hyphens, apostrophes/periods removed (e.g. 'Sitrus Berry' -> 'sitrus-berry', 'Never-Melt Ice' -> 'never-melt-ice')
meta.levelRule: the highest-level Pokemon of each trainer is exactly the level cap; the others are 1-2 levels below
